product_metadata.title: Wedding Photo Booth Props - 41-pc Wedding Props with 8 x 10-Inch Sign, 45 Glue Dots, 35 Wooden Sticks - Signs for Wedding Backdrop and Selfie Station
features: Perfect Wedding and Bachelorette Party Selfies: These wedding picture props are the perfect addition to your wedding photobooth. Set includes 30 props, one 8x10" sign, 45 glue dots, and 35 sticks.
Inspire Creative Photos: With a variety of colorful props, you and your guests can capture the perfect wedding photos. These family friendly wedding booth props work well for all ages.
From Rehearsal Dinner to Wedding Reception: Our wedding selfie props are printed on high-quality cardstock that won’t easily bend or tear so you can have more fun and capture more memories.
Versatile and Multipurpose: Use these wedding props for photobooth fun, bachelorette party activities, wedding favors, or as table decor at your reception.
Vibrant Color and Real Glitter: These photobooth wedding party props feature real glitter to make your photos shine. The colorful photo booth wedding props are sure to stand out.
description: Create lasting memories at your wedding photo booth with this deluxe set of 31 props. Beautiful creative pictures are the perfect way to remember your special day. That's why our deluxe set of 31 photo booth prop cutouts is the perfect addition to your wedding festivities. You'll receive 30 assorted unique and durable themed cardstock cutouts designed in the USA and printed in vibrant color with gold and silver color glitter, 1 "Grab a Prop and Strike a Pose" sign to make sure your guests join in the photobooth fun, 31 wooden dowels and plenty of adhesive strips so you have the supplies to make assembly a breeze. Set up the included “Grab a prop and strike a pose” sign with the cutouts kit to make sure your guests don't hesitate to grab a camera and join in the fun and games. With 31 unique props and endless possibilities, you, your friends and family will be sure to laugh and smile as you create lasting memories together. Whether you are celebrating your engagement, bridal shower, wedding, reception, bachelorette party, bachelor party, anniversary, or renewing of vows this rustic backdrop set is the perfect way to capture fun and silly memories. These props not only provide a fun activity, but also make perfect accessories for your wedding decor. Hang them on the wall, use them as cake toppers, place them with your flowers or bouquet, hand them out to guests as favors, or incorporate them into your diy or vintage decorations. After the event, include the signs in your bride & groom wedding scrapbook for a memorable keepsake.
